Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: After WebSurfer established that Jean Bretagne Charles de La Trémoille (the subject’s father) was the son of Charles Armand René de La Trémoille, which already identifies the paternal grandfather, the Planner misinterpreted the lineage and unnecessarily looked one generation further. This led to incorrectly naming Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille (the great-grandfather) as the paternal grandfather, ignoring the correct synthesis that the paternal grandfather is Charles Armand René de La Trémoille.
